description: This source file defines a Java class MainMethodExceptionHandler that provides a mechanism to execute a Runnable (represented by Callable<ActorSystem>) with exception handling. It logs and re-throws any Throwable or Exception encountered during execution, mainly designed to wrap the main method execution and capture all throwables, including Errors and RuntimeExceptions.
